summary: Build LinkedIn social selling and executive visibility skills with practical tools, AI-assisted workflows, and measurable exercises.
lede: LinkedIn social selling helps professionals already using the platform build visibility, identify priority relationships and start relevant commercial conversations. Training covers profile audits and searchability, thought-leadership content planning, account prospecting and executive engagement, with practice creating a content calendar and outreach sequence. Participants also learn to track Social Selling Index progress, engagement and pipeline-linked indicators, and align visibility activity with governance expectations.
audienceIntro: This course is intended for professionals who already use LinkedIn and now need a more structured way to build visibility, start relevant conversations, and measure impact. It fits individual contributors, managers, and leaders who operate at the intersection of personal brand, sales activity, and corporate reputation.
prerequisites: You need a laptop, an active LinkedIn profile, and access to your current sales or visibility materials, such as a bio, profile summary, content examples, or target account list. If available, bring LinkedIn Sales Navigator, CRM notes, approved brand language, and recent engagement data so you can complete the exercises with real work artifacts.
